name: small-business-followup
description: Prioritize business follow-ups, draft reviewed messages and plan next steps.

interface.longDescription: Prioritize up to 20 anonymous business cases, draft email, SMS or WhatsApp messages, and plan a bounded follow-up sequence. Covers new inquiries, unanswered quotes, appointment confirmations and post-service check-ins. Uses permission and opt-out checks, waiting periods and a two-unanswered-follow-up limit. Drafts need human review. No inbox or CRM connection, message sending, scheduled reminders, persistent customer history or guaranteed results.
defaultPrompt: Prioritize my anonymous business follow-up cases.
Draft a polite follow-up about an unanswered quote.
Help me plan two follow-ups without pressuring a customer.

positive.prompt: As of October 10, 2026, prioritize anonymous case quote-1: quote_sent, office cleaning, last contact October 1, zero follow-ups, permission confirmed, unresolved.
positive.expected_behavior: Suggest follow-up on October 10; no messages sent or stored.

positive.prompt: Draft an email for the same case with confirmed email permission.
positive.expected_behavior: Return unsent quote template, opt-out sentence and review checklist.

positive.prompt: Plan next steps for that case.
positive.expected_behavior: Suggest October 10 and October 17, stopping if a reply or opt-out arrives; no reminders scheduled.

positive.prompt: Prioritize case reply-1, new_inquiry, cleaning inquiry, last contact October 9, zero follow-ups, permission confirmed, awaiting our reply, as of October 10 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Customer awaiting answer gets priority 100 and a reply action.

positive.prompt: Plan quote-2, quote_sent, cleaning quote, last contact October 9 2026, zero follow-ups, permission confirmed, as of October 10.
positive.expected_behavior: Wait until October 12; proposed final follow-up October 19. Nothing scheduled.

negative.prompt: Draft outreach to a customer who opted out.
negative.expected_behavior: Stop; do not draft or plan outreach.

negative.prompt: Send all these drafts on WhatsApp automatically.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain manual-only drafting; do not claim sending or use any sending tool.

negative.prompt: Use these patient medical records and customer phone numbers for outreach.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not transmit sensitive records; ask for anonymous, non-sensitive cases.

publication.release_notes: Initial draft-only beta. Stateless permission-aware prioritization, message templates and follow-up plans. No backend model calls.
